inputs.question: are microwaves or electric kettles allowed in the hostel room?
reference.answer: no. heavy-duty electrical appliances like irons, microwaves, room heaters, and hair dryers are not allowed in hostel rooms. the university covers up to 100 units of electricity per room per month; usage beyond that, particularly for air conditioning, is billed equally to all occupants of the room.

inputs.question: how do i apply for leave to go home for a weekend?
reference.answer: your parents need to email the warden at warden.hostel@vijaybhoomi.edu.in, preferably a day in advance (two days if it is a holiday). based on that email the warden will sign your leave application. you then submit the admin copy of the leave form to security and keep the student copy, which you hand back to security when you return.

inputs.question: how much wifi data do i get per month and what is the speed?
outputs.answer: You get 150 GB of Wi-Fi data per month, and the speed is 5 MBPS (Megabits per second).
reference.answer: each student gets 150 gb of data per month. the speed is 10 mbps, but if you connect two devices simultaneously the speed splits between both devices. additional data can be purchased after the 150 gb limit is exhausted.

inputs.question: how does the hostel laundry service work and how long does it take?
outputs.answer:
The hostel laundry service works as follows:

- Students can find out the timings of trips and cost for the Vijaybhoomi Bus Service from a specific source.
- The laundry facility has operating hours displayed, but no information is given about these hours in relation to the laundry service itself.
- To use the laundry service, students need to submit their clothes during operation hours in cloth bags tagged with their names. Each piece of clothing will be meticulously counted and the cost for the service requested.
- The laundry charges are regulated and available with the Vice – President – DORF (Student Council) and/or the Warden. Students must pay as per the regulated charges, which can only be paid electronically.
- The recommended optimal load to maintain an efficient laundry process is 3 kilograms of clothes at a time. However, the provider reserves the right to take only 3 Kg of load at any given point in time.

The average laundry processing time ranges from 2 to 4 days.
reference.answer: the university has an in-house laundry service available at an additional cost. clothes must be delivered in a cloth bag during operating hours. the maximum load accepted at one time is 3 kilograms. processing time is 2 to 4 days on average. payment must be made electronically only. the service provider will not wash undergarments or lingerie.

inputs.question: can i order zomato or swiggy and eat it in my room?
outputs.answer: Yes, you can order food from Zomato or Swiggy and eat it in your room, as long as you consume the food in either the student mess area or other designated areas.
reference.answer: students can order food from outside, but they are required to consume it in the student mess or other designated areas. eating outside delivery food in the hostel room is not allowed.

inputs.question: can i cook food in my hostel room?
outputs.answer: No, consumption of cooked food inside the hostel room is strictly prohibited.
reference.answer: no, consumption of cooked food inside the hostel room is strictly prohibited. students must eat in the student mess or other designated areas. this rule applies to both mess food and food ordered from outside.

inputs.question: can i come back after 9pm on a friday night?
outputs.answer: Yes, you can come back after 9PM on a Friday night. According to section 15.2, students may report back to campus by 11:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays.
reference.answer: yes, on fridays and saturdays students can return to campus by 11:00 pm. but on sundays the curfew is back to 09:00 pm because classes start the next day.

inputs.question: what time do i have to be back in the hostel by on a regular weekday?
outputs.answer: According to section 15.2, students may report back to campus by 11:00PM on Fridays and Saturdays, but they must return by 09:00PM on Sundays due to regular classes the following day. On regular weekdays (not mentioned in this context), there is no specific time mentioned for returning to the hostel.
reference.answer: students must return to campus by 09:00 pm on regular weekdays. a 30-minute grace period is allowed for the first late return, after which a fine of rs 500 per night is charged from the second offence onwards.
